fields.Name: IT98 - Rubric Immutability Triggers
fields.Description: Deterministic server-side Rubrics bundle, sequence 49, ahead of the client-transport tests. Raw SQL must throw 51101-51110. Publishing classifies 1.0.0 Initial and a weight change as 2.0.0 Major. Submit stores the RubricScoring result. A second submit supersedes the first, and that evaluation can be withdrawn. The cohort mean matches the engine Mean and leaves Self out. Deleting a draft removes its tree. Fixtures roll back. Requires RUN_MUTATION_TESTS because every check writes.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 51101-51110 fire where a frozen write is attempted; publish classifies Initial then Major; submit matches RubricScoring; supersede and withdraw succeed; the cohort mean matches the engine Mean.
